markingScheme: +4 for algorithm correctness, -1 for boundary/stack overflow errors, step-marking enabled for partial proof

questions.questionText: Demonstrate list aliasing with memory diagrams when assigning list b to list a.
questions.markingCriteria: 2 marks for memory diagram showing single heap object, 3 marks for code explanation.
questions.commonTraps: Confusing deep copy with shallow reference assignment.

questions.questionText: Implement a binary search loop with strict boundary interval invariants.
questions.markingCriteria: 5 marks for loop termination condition (low <= high), 5 marks for mid calculation.
questions.commonTraps: Integer overflow in mid calculation, off-by-one in mid - 1.

questions.questionText: Explain why passing the output of a function that uses print() to another calculation causes TypeError.
questions.markingCriteria: 7 marks for explaining NoneType return value, 8 marks for code trace.
questions.commonTraps: Assuming print() assigns value to result variable.

questions.questionText: Trace the activation records for recursive merge sort on array of size 8.
questions.markingCriteria: 10 marks for call tree diagram, 10 marks for stack frame base cases.
questions.commonTraps: Omitting base case when left index >= right index.
